New standard and/ or amendments:
Amendments to IAS 21,
‘The Effects of Changes in
Foreign Exchange Rates’
‑ Lack of Exchangeability
(Amendments to IAS 21)
Details of the amendments:
An entity is impacted by the amendments when it has
a transaction or an operation in a foreign currency that
is not exchangeable into another currency at a mea‑
surement date for a specified purpose. A currency is
exchangeable when there is an ability to obtain the
other currency (with a normal administrative delay), and
the transaction would take place through a market or
exchange mechanism that creates enforceable rights
and obligations.
Assessment of the impact on the Group fi:
The Group anticipates
no material impact
to its financial state‑
ments.

New standard and/ or amendments:
Amendment to IFRS 16,
‘Leases’ ‑ sale and lease‑
back
Details of the amendments:
These amendments include requirements for sale and
leaseback transactions in IFRS 16 to explain how an en‑
tity accounts for a sale and leaseback after the date of
the transaction. Sale and leaseback transactions where
some or all the lease payments are variable lease pay‑
ments that do not depend on an index or rate are most
likely to be impacted.
Assessment of the impact on the Group fi:
The Group anticipates
no impact to its finan‑
cial statements.
